plugin.name: dim-inactive
plugin._long: Dims every window that does not have the keyboard focus, so the active window stands out. Uses the obs plugin for drawing: enable "obs" as well.

option.name: toggle
option._long: Switches dimming on and off (it is on when the plugin is loaded). Also available as the IPC method dim-inactive/toggle.

option.name: brightness
option._long: Brightness of windows without focus, in percent (100 = not dimmed).

option.name: saturation
option._long: Colour saturation of windows without focus, in percent (100 = unchanged, 0 = grey).

option.name: opacity
option._long: Opacity of windows without focus, in percent (100 = opaque).

option.name: duration
option._long: Duration of the dim / undim fade in milliseconds.

option.name: exclude
option._long: Windows matching this condition are never dimmed, e.g. app_id is "mpv". "none" = no exception.
